title: A note waits past your attention and becomes a wake

steps.text: how is the health check going?
steps.why: Engaged for 3 minutes, not the default 10, so the Lab need not wait ten real minutes; the offline suite tests the 10-minute default in TestConversion
Finishes at about 12 s; the item is ripe at about 102 s, while you are still engaged, so it goes in as a note
You prompt nothing more: the engagement window ends at 3 minutes

expect.name: converted
expect.why: The note became a turn once you had not prompted for the whole window

expect.name: one-message
expect.why: It is the same message, converted in place, not a second one
